trial_court: Family Court No.1, Jodhpur, Civil Original Suit No.1091/2023
case_name: Abhyjeet Mahesh Bhansali vs Maloo Vidhi Kewalchand
facts_of_case: Marriage of the petitioner and respondent was solemnized on 09.12.2020. After marriage, respondent went to her matrimonial house and resided with the petitioner's family members. Due to marital disharmony and dispute, they mutually filed an application under Section 13B of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. The court below rejected their application vide order dated 18.10.2023.

legal_principles.principle: The waiver of the waiting period for the second motion will be in the discretion of the court concerned.
legal_principles.held: The waiver application can be filed one week after the first motion giving reasons for the prayer for waiver. If the above conditions are satisfied, the waiver of the waiting period for the second motion will be in the discretion of the court concerned.
cited_cases: Amardeep Singh Vs. Harveen Kaur, (2017) 8 SCC 746

outcome.final_order: The impugned order dated 18.10.2023 passed by the learned Family Court No.1, Jodhpur may kindly be quashed and set aside. The statutory period of six months specified under Section 13B(2) of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 may kindly be waived off.
